units.title: Sealed causal diagnosis and admission repair
units.scope: Before inspecting the test source, seal predictions and the first invalid state. Repair failure-atomic admission and retain a delayed changed-capacity variant.
units.remaining_evidence: Independent changed-condition implementation, design defense and complete parent-project obligations.
steps: Write the state, ownership and failure contract; predict normal, boundary and fault cases.
Implement the selected mechanism against the imported interfaces without reading assessor code.
Run the semantic gate and a deliberate negative control; minimize a disagreement.
Change one capacity, timing, ownership or failure assumption and record the design consequence.
checks: The supplied learner scaffold builds and does not pass this semantic gate.
The explicit assessor passes and the corresponding mutation is rejected.
